user: hey can u send the doc whenever u get a sec thx

assistant.main: Could you send the document when you get a chance? Thanks.

learningPhrases.gloss: a polite request to send it
learningPhrases.grammar: Could you softens a request with a modal verb; it does not describe a past ability here.

assistant.rationale: Cleaned up the chat-shorthand ("u" → "you"), softened the imperative into a request with "Could you", and added normal capitalization: keeps the friendly tone but reads like a polished message rather than a quick text.

alternatives.text: Whenever you have a moment, could you send over the doc? Thanks!
alternatives.note: Leads with the time flexibility, which softens the ask further. Keeps the informal "doc" shorthand.

alternatives.text: Please send the document when you have a sec: no rush, thanks.
alternatives.note: Direct and polite; the "no rush" makes the casual "sec" feel considerate rather than sloppy.
